data.messageTransform:
(

  $d := $state.context.REQUEST.DATA;
  
  $isNilOrEmpty($d.lines)  
  ?
    "Add All Lines of Sales Order #"
      & $d.salesOrder.number
      & " to Load #"
      & $d.load.number
      & "?"
  :
    "Add Lines "
      & $join($d.lines.number, ", ")
      & " of Sales Order #"
      & $d.salesOrder.number
      & " to Load #"
      & $d.load.number
      & "?"
)
"Could not complete action. No Sales Order Provided!"
"Could not complete action. No Shipment Provided!"
